reason: The support is still a single paper (SWE-Gate, arXiv:2609.04167): about 34% of functionally passing agent repairs violate constraints derived from real PR reviews. No independent replication or second benchmark has been recorded since the 2026-09-28 review. The mechanism is plausible and a replication package exists. RMD-REVIEWGATE-001 (codify review constraints, do not gate on functional tests alone) is a current candidate. Keep unverified.

evidence.summary: 221 of 644 functionally passing repairs violate review-derived constraints; replication package public.
candidate; codify reviewer constraints (Copilot custom instructions/REVIEW.md) as a PR gate in addition to functional tests.
